title: uxc fd.guiconfig meta (fd/guiconfig/<id>/meta.json)
description: A GUIConfiguration document (Spring-bean XML next to this meta, fd.guiconfig). Only name, acl, registrationOrder and contentFile are read; other keys are ignored by push but show as drift.

$schema.description: Editor hint only: uxc ignores it (never hashed, never pushed).

registrationOrder.description: RegistrationOrder tag as an integer STRING, inside the manifest band: bean-id collision precedence.

contentFile.description: File name of the XML next to meta.json (default "<id>.xml").
